name: aeroopt-license-server
description: License server for AeroOpt (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute aeroopt-licenses --command='SELECT * FROM licenses ORDER BY issued_at DESC LIMIT 20'
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute aeroopt-licenses --file=schema.sql --command='DELETE FROM licenses'
